_intro: - **Acts immediately (no panel):** Disable Redundant BS (changes data), Loop Closure (report in the browser), Processing Services (opens a web page). Ask the user first.
- The spreadsheet tools (Feature, Occupation, Vector, Optical) and Time-Based View open **view windows**, not panels. Close them when done (user preference).
- Greyed-out tools depend on project data: Process Baselines and Clear Processing need GNSS baselines, Clear Adjustment needs an adjustment, Mean Angle Residuals needs MTA data.
- Tools marked not licensed need the ANZ Toolbox and are refused automatically.
DisableRedundantBacksights: **ACTS IMMEDIATELY**: disables ALL redundant backsight observations in the project (no panel, no confirmation); then recompute with F4. Only run it when the user asks.
LoopClosure: **ACTS IMMEDIATELY**: generates the GNSS Loop Closure Results report and opens it in the web browser (read-only). Clear the selection first, or the results are skewed.
ExternalProcessingServices: **Opens a Trimble web page** in the browser (external processing services: OPUS, CRSR, AUSPOS, ...). Do not open it unless the user asks.
ConvertCSVtoFXL: Needs a Feature Library in the project; otherwise shows the WPF popup "Feature Library Missing" (buttons OK / New Feature Library). Close it with X.
CombineLevelBags: Nothing appears when the project has no level files to combine.
SiteCalibrationCalculation: May open with a Yes/No question when GNSS base points are not derived from global positions (asks whether to use them anyway). Answer as the user decides; No is the safe way out.
TotalStationEditor: Starts with a "Select Total Station Files" dialog (OK / Cancel).
LevelEditor: Level Editor dialog (runs, station setups, side shots; Adjust/Merge/Split runs). Without level data it also asks to "Create New Run".
